full.description: This is a micrograph showing a histological section of breast tissue. The image reveals an infiltrative proliferation of malignant epithelial cells forming cords and nests within a desmoplastic stroma, characteristic of invasive breast carcinoma. A benign ductal structure with cribriform architecture can be seen near the top right corner. The findings are indicative of invasive ductal carcinoma of the breast.

random.description: This is a micrograph of breast tissue stained with hematoxylin and eosin. The image displays cords and nests of malignant epithelial cells infiltrating through a dense, fibrous stroma (desmoplasia). These microscopic features are characteristic of invasive ductal carcinoma of the breast. Additionally, areas of ductal carcinoma in situ may be present in the surrounding tissue.
